rule: Curated, source-linked additions to the Frameworks directory on Hub page 3198. The page renders NHS Supply Chain frameworks live from frameworks.json (Contract Launch Briefs, weekly) and their next tender from nhssc-procurement-calendar.json (daily). This file holds only what those two cannot: frameworks run by other bodies, and one-off signals read at a named source. Every entry was checked at its source on the date given. The page hides any framework whose end date has passed, so a stale row drops off rather than showing as live.
